table_assessment.assessment_notes: Isolated guideline-summary table containing twenty normative rows across heart failure, valvular and aortic disease, cardiomyopathies, myocarditis, and pericarditis. Multiple rows duplicate disease-specific recommendation tables, so it is not an independent table example.

entities.surface_form: a preliminary optimization of HF risk factor control and therapy
device implantation
if appropriate

header_path: Recommendations for participation in sports in heart failure

normative_assertions.notes: Optimization precedes sport consideration; device implantation applies only when appropriate.

text_units.verbatim_text: Before considering a sport activity, a preliminary optimization of HF risk factor control and therapy, including device implantation (if appropriate), is recommended.

entities.surface_form: High-intensity power and endurance sports
patients with HFrEF irrespective of symptoms

header_path: Recommendations for participation in sports in heart failure

normative_assertions.notes: The against recommendation explicitly applies irrespective of symptoms.

text_units.verbatim_text: High-intensity power and endurance sports are not recommended in patients with HFrEF irrespective of symptoms.

entities.surface_form: Moderate endurance and dynamic resistance exercise
lifestyle intervention
optimal treatment of CV risk factors
arterial hypertension and type 2 diabetes

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and participation in sports in individuals with heart failure and preserved ejection fraction

normative_assertions.notes: Exercise and lifestyle intervention are represented together as recommended actions.

Treatment of the stated cardiovascular risk factors is kept as a distinct normative action. Second-pass source-fidelity adjudication corrected the operation type; source wording and direction are unchanged.

text_units.verbatim_text: Moderate endurance and dynamic resistance exercise, together with lifestyle intervention and optimal treatment of CV risk factors (i.e. arterial hypertension and type 2 diabetes) are recommended.

entities.surface_form: Regular exercise through cardiac rehabilitation combining moderate-intensity aerobic and resistance exercise
revert pathophysiology to pre-transplantation time
CV risk induced by post-transplantation medical treatment
clinical outcome

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and participation in sports in individuals with heart transplant recipients

normative_assertions.notes: Purposes remain outcomes of the recommendation and are not encoded as standalone causal facts.

text_units.verbatim_text: Regular exercise through cardiac rehabilitation combining moderate-intensity aerobic and resistance exercise is recommended to revert pathophysiology to pre-transplantation time, reduce CV risk induced by post-transplantation medical treatment, and improve clinical outcome.

entities.surface_form: Participation in competitive or recreational sports/exercise of moderate and high intensity
individuals with severe aortic stenosis

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in asymptomatic individuals with valvular heart disease

normative_assertions.notes: Against recommendation for severe aortic stenosis.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in competitive or recreational sports/exercise of moderate and high intensity is not recommended in individuals with severe aortic stenosis.

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in asymptomatic individuals with valvular heart disease

normative_assertions.notes: Exact source-visible LaTeX-like threshold text is retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in competitive or recreational sports/exercise of moderate and high intensity is not recommended in individuals with severe aortic regurgitation with LVEF ≤50% and/or exercise-induced arrhythmias.

individuals with severe mitral regurgitation with a LVEF<60%

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in asymptomatic individuals with valvular heart disease

normative_assertions.notes: Against recommendation retains the LVEF threshold.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in competitive sports is not recommended in individuals with severe mitral regurgitation with a LVEF<60%.

individuals with severe (MVA<1 cm2) mitral stenosis

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in asymptomatic individuals with valvular heart disease

normative_assertions.notes: Against recommendation retains the MVA threshold.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in any competitive sport, or leisure sports/exercise of mild to moderate intensity, is not recommended in individuals with severe (MVA<1 cm2) mitral stenosis.

entities.surface_form: risk stratification, with careful assessment including advanced imaging of the aorta (CT/CMR) and exercise testing with BP assessment

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with aortic pathology

normative_assertions.notes: The assessment components and their pre-exercise timing are preserved verbatim.

text_units.verbatim_text: Prior to engaging in exercise, risk stratification, with careful assessment including advanced imaging of the aorta (CT/CMR) and exercise testing with BP assessment, is recommended.

entities.surface_form: Competitive sports
individuals who are at high risk (Table 14)

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with aortic pathology

normative_assertions.notes: The source defines high risk only by its Table 14 cross-reference; no unstated criteria are inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Competitive sports are not recommended in individuals who are at high risk (Table 14).

entities.surface_form: Annual assessment for risk stratification
all individuals with cardiomyopathy who exercise regularly

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with cardiomyopathy

normative_assertions.notes: Annual assessment recommendation.

text_units.verbatim_text: Annual assessment for risk stratification is recommended in all individuals with cardiomyopathy who exercise regularly.

entities.surface_form: Participation in high-intensity exercise (including recreational and competitive sports)

individuals who have ANY markers of increased risk [(i) cardiac symptoms or history of cardiac arrest or unexplained syncope; (ii) moderate ESC risk score (≥4%) at 5 years; (iii) LVOT gradient at rest >30 mmHg; (iv) abnormal BP response to exercise; (v) exercise-induced arrhythmias]

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and sports participation in individuals with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy

normative_assertions.notes: All five alternative risk-marker criteria and exact source-visible math text are retained in the population span.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in high-intensity exercise (including recreational and competitive sports) is not recommended in individuals who have ANY markers of increased risk [(i) cardiac symptoms or history of cardiac arrest or unexplained syncope; (ii) moderate ESC risk score (≥4%) at 5 years; (iii) LVOT gradient at rest >30 mmHg; (iv) abnormal BP response to exercise; (v) exercise-induced arrhythmias].

entities.surface_form: Participation in high-intensity recreational exercise/sports or any competitive sports
individuals with ACM including those who are genotype positive and phenotype negative

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and sports participation in individuals with arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy

normative_assertions.notes: Genotype-positive, phenotype-negative individuals are explicitly included.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in high-intensity recreational exercise/sports or any competitive sports is not recommended in individuals with ACM including those who are genotype positive and phenotype negative.

entities.surface_form: Participation in high-intensity exercise or competitive sports
individuals with symptoms, LVEF<40% and/or frequent and/or complex VAs on ambulatory Holter monitoring or exercise testing

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and sports participation in individuals with left ventricular non-compaction cardiomyopathy

normative_assertions.notes: All alternative clinical and test-based criteria are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in high-intensity exercise or competitive sports is not recommended in individuals with symptoms, LVEF<40% and/or frequent and/or complex VAs on ambulatory Holter monitoring or exercise testing.

entities.surface_form: Participation in high- or very high-intensity exercise including competitive sports

individuals with a DCM and any of the following: (i) symptoms or history of cardiac arrest or unexplained syncope; (ii) LVEF<45%; (iii) frequent and/or complex VAs on ambulatory Holter monitoring or exercise testing; (iv) extensive LGE (>20%) on CMR; or (v) high-risk genotype (lamin A/C or filamin C)

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and sports participation in individuals with dilated cardiomyopathy

normative_assertions.notes: All five alternative risk criteria are retained in the population span.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in high- or very high-intensity exercise including competitive sports is not recommended for individuals with a DCM and any of the following: (i) symptoms or history of cardiac arrest or unexplained syncope; (ii) LVEF<45%; (iii) frequent and/or complex VAs on ambulatory Holter monitoring or exercise testing; (iv) extensive LGE (>20%) on CMR; or (v) high-risk genotype (lamin A/C or filamin C).

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with myocarditis and pericarditis

normative_assertions.notes: Post-recovery evaluation recommendation.

text_units.verbatim_text: Comprehensive evaluation, using imaging studies, exercise stress test, and Holter monitoring, is recommended following recovery from acute myocarditis to assess the risk of exercise-related SCD.

entities.surface_form: Return to all forms of exercise including competitive sports
30 days to 3 months of rest
individuals who have recovered completely from acute pericarditis
clinical severity

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with myocarditis and pericarditis

normative_assertions.notes: Rest duration is a severity-dependent range.

text_units.verbatim_text: Return to all forms of exercise including competitive sports is recommended after 30 days to 3 months of rest for individuals who have recovered completely from acute pericarditis, depending on clinical severity.

entities.surface_form: individuals with a probable or definitive diagnosis of recent myocarditis or pericarditis
participation in leisure-time or competitive sports
active inflammation is present

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with myocarditis and pericarditis

normative_assertions.notes: The recommendation against sport is limited to active inflammation.

text_units.verbatim_text: Among individuals with a probable or definitive diagnosis of recent myocarditis or pericarditis, participation in leisure-time or competitive sports while active inflammation is present is not recommended.

entities.surface_form: Participation in moderate- to high-intensity exercise
a period of 3–6 months after acute myocarditis

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with myocarditis and pericarditis

normative_assertions.notes: Post-myocarditis duration is preserved.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in moderate- to high-intensity exercise for a period of 3–6 months after acute myocarditis is not recommended.

individuals with constrictive pericarditis

header_path: Recommendations for exercise in individuals with myocarditis and pericarditis

normative_assertions.notes: Against recommendation for constrictive pericarditis.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in moderate- to high-intensity exercise, including competitive sports, is not recommended for individuals with constrictive pericarditis.
